description: This file defines an authentication store using Zustand for state management, including login, logout, signup, and fetching user info functionalities. It persists state in localStorage and interacts with an API service.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Sets the authentication token in the store.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user information in the store.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears authentication data and optionally notifies backend to logout.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email/username and password, stores token and user on success.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Registers a new user with email/username and password.

methods.name: fetchMe
methods.description: Fetches current user data if token exists and handles invalid sessions.
